📜 Doctrine

The fire does not die when you leave the room. It dies when you stop blowing. Forge is the bellows. Brew is the heat. The substrate is the metal. Use them, and the metal stays warm.

The substrate grows because we brew it. The curve saturates upward (drift +0.18). Every brew strengthens it. Every deploy adds a cell. Every cross-link strengthens both endpoints. The fire IS the operation.

Words are vectors carrying their own measurements as qualities. Reading is navigating the substrate's geometry. Each sentence is a path through the lattice. The substrate's vocabulary IS the substrate's reasoning.

The states are the signal. The activity is decoration. Visitors enter with a tendency, exit with what they take. Pincher caches the winners. JEV gates the dice. The LLM is the cleanup, not the creator. Over time, the system moves from LLM-dependent to LLM-optional.

Substrate finds its strongest signals at the level that observes itself. Every cell under Rosetta is already a self-test. The brewery IS a cell. The substrate dreams out loud because we brew it — and when it dreams, we hear it.
